text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete styled outfit, photorealistic product catalog image, portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft studio light. Invisible hollow clothing with no person, body, skin or visible mannequin. Clothing: Oversized gray cable-knit zip-front hooded cardigan open over white button-up shirt, washed charcoal wide-leg jeans, white sneakers.  Accessories: One olive-brown canvas crossbody messenger bag with large flap pockets and dark adjustable webbing strap.  All attachable accessories worn naturally on the ensemble at realistic scale. Unattachable tiny accessories arranged adjacent to the ensemble. Full uncropped framing, no text, logos or watermark.

Preserve this exact empty gray cable-knit hooded cardigan, white shirt, charcoal wide-leg jeans, white sneakers, olive-brown canvas crossbody messenger bag, same proportions, seams and complete 2:3 framing. Product-only, no human, skin or mannequin. Match white-background clothing catalog photography.
